title: The Maasai: Culture, Cattle and Change
excerpt: The Maasai are one of the best-known peoples of East Africa. An introduction to their culture, cattle and the changes they face.
body:
## Who are the Maasai?

The Maasai are pastoralists who live in northern Tanzania and southern Kenya. They speak Maa.

## Cattle

Cattle are central to Maasai life, as wealth, food and in ceremonies.

## Homes

Traditional homes (enkaji) are built by women from branches, mud and dung, in an enclosure (boma).

## Age sets

Life is structured in age sets. Young men become warriors (morans) and later elders.

## Clothing

The red shuka cloth and beadwork are well known.

## Change

Land pressure, education, tourism and climate change affect Maasai life. Many Maasai combine tradition and modern life.

## Respect

See [visiting a Maasai village respectfully](/blog/visiting-maasai-respectfully/). [Plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
